subject: Urgent: EU account surge seat + provisional comp-band exception request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:13:00-05:00
Subject: Urgent: EU account surge seat + provisional comp-band exception request

Hi Jonas / Laura —

Quick context: Acme Analytics (regional HQ in Dublin) just notified us they plan to expand usage with three new product modules starting Nov 15. The AM team forecasts a 3x increase in managed inference volume and has asked for a dedicated AE + SE to support the ramp and several onsite workshops (two in-person weeks in Dec). They want Redwood to commit to named coverage for the next 6 months as a condition of the ARR upsell.

Ask: I am requesting provisional approval for one EMEA AE (field AE, seat to be hired or converted from contractor) and one Solutions Engineer (SE) seat for an initial 6-month surge window. Because this is time-sensitive and tied to an active expansion (DEAL-ACME-2026-09), I also request a one-time variance to the published comp bands for the AE candidate only: increase the variable component to 45% OTE from the standard 35% and a $25k one-time sign-on to hit candidate expectations. Base remains within band.

Why exception is justified:
- High-probability upsell (forecasted incremental ARR ~ $1.2M over 12 months)
- Competitive urgency — Acme is evaluating a competing provider starting in Q1 if we don't move fast
- Short-term (6mo) seat; the role will be re-evaluated at the surge's end for permanent conversion

Attachments: acme_q4_account_surge_plan.pdf (AM ask + timeline), provisional_mlp_request_sheet.xlsx (comp math and seat budget).

Requested approvals:
- Jonas: headcount approval (provisional 6-month)
- Laura / People: sign-off for the comp-band variance and sign-on approval
- Marcus / Finance: confirmation that projected incremental ARR covers the one-time sign-on and variable uplift (summary P&L)

Proposed timing: post an int-req this week (if approved) and start active sourcing immediately. Candidate target start date = Nov 30 (for training prior to Dec workshops).

I know this is fast — happy to jump on a 30-min sync right after your calendars if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Regional Sales Lead, EMEA
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: EU account surge seat + provisional comp-band exception request

Sean —

Thanks for the clear note and attachments. High level: I support the provisional headcount given the deal signal and the short horizon. I also think the AE comp tweak is reasonable as a one-time, deal-driven exception — but we need tighter guardrails. Conditions I want before final sign-off: 

1) Written AM commitment from Acme (email or SOW) that outlines the workshops and committed ARR uplift (we need sign-off to treat as revenue-backed spend).
2) A 6-month review milestone: end-of-March check-in to determine conversion or sunsetting the seats. If the seat converts, the standard comp band and budget must be applied going forward.
3) A cap on total cash spend for the uplift/sign-on not to exceed $60k combined (to be covered by the deal). If actuals look to exceed that, the AE/SE hiring must be paused.

Laura / Marcus — can you confirm People + Finance checks? If you can do a quick thumbs-up by EOD today I will mark as provisionally approved and instruct Talent to open reqs.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Sales - EMEA
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: EU account surge seat + provisional comp-band exception request

Jonas / Sean —

People side: we can support a one-time deviation for the AE band under the following conditions:
- Written sponsor from Acme confirming the timeline and expected ARR uplift (Jonas, can you paste that when received)
- Offer packet should explicitly label the role as a 6-month provisional assignment with conversion determined by the March review
- Sign-on will be paid in two installments: 50% at start, 50% after 90 days, tied to delivery milestones in the AM plan

Recruiting note: I'll pull in a sourcer immediately and target a candidate slate within two weeks. We will prioritize internal conversions first (contractor -> full time) to reduce ramp and cost.

Marcus — please confirm the $60k cap and whether Finance will allow the sign-on to be treated as a sales marketing expense against the Q4 uplift.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: EU account surge seat + provisional comp-band exception request

All —

Finance check completed after reviewing the attached ACME plan + HubSpot revenue note. We can absorb up to $60k of incremental spend (sign-on + incremental variable) against the forecasted upsell for Q4 provided:

- We receive the written customer commitment (SOW or signed email) by EOB Nov 6
- Cost will be tracked to Deal-level P&L (DEAL-ACME-2026-09) and reported as a professional services / ramp expense in Q4

I also confirm the sign-on payment schedule Laura proposed is acceptable from a cash-flow perspective. Please proceed with opening a provisional requisition and start candidate outreach. Keep recruiting and finance in the loop on any verbal acceptances — we'd like to capture offers and projected cash impact ahead of payout.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
